name: aivi-home-assistant
description: The aivi panel frontend (Lit + TypeScript in frontend/src, built by Vite to the gitignored bundle custom_components/aivi/frontend/aivi-panel.js and its lazily loaded, content-hashed template editor aivi-code-editor-<hash>.js) plus the snapshot harness.

scripts.build: vite build --config frontend/vite.editor.config.ts && vite build --config frontend/vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json
